ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.description: The first card you draw each turn is [gold]Infused[/gold], or gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold] if it is already enchanted.
ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.flavor: It has opinions about which page matters.
ALCHEMIST-AURIC_SEAL.title: Auric Seal
ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.description: At the start of each combat, heal [green]3[/green] HP and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.flavor: Foul on the tongue, kind to the wound.
ALCHEMIST-BITTERROOT.title: Bitterroot
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.descriptio: At the start of each combat, choose a [gold]Mix+[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It gains [gold]Retain[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.flavor: However much you pour, it never quite runs dry.
ALCHEMIST-EVERFLOWING_CHALICE.title: Everflowing Chalice
ALCHEMIST-EXTRA_DOSE.flavor: A measured dose, always within reach.
ALCHEMIST-EXTRA_DOSE.title: Extra Dose
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold]. You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites. Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] potion slot.
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.flavor: An ornate case. The gold is not for show.
ALCHEMIST-GILDED_KIT.title: Gilded Kit
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.description: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Unripe Fruit[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.flavor: Midas chose poorly, but he planted well.
ALCHEMIST-MIDAS_FRUIT.title: Midas Fruit
ALCHEMIST-MOTHER_OF_VINEGAR.flavor: A spoonful of the last batch wakes the next.
ALCHEMIST-MOTHER_OF_VINEGAR.title: Mother of Vinegar
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.flavor: What gets through the first one still has this to argue with.
ALCHEMIST-SECOND_SKIN.title: Second Skin
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] and [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Antitoxin[/gold]. You can [gold]Brew[/gold] at Rest Sites.
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.flavor: A well worn and pleasantly smelling case.
ALCHEMIST-WEATHERED_KIT.title: Weathered Kit
